Patna Student Protest : daroga bharti pariksha radd hone se aakrosh, Police aur chhatron men halki jharap
Daroga bharti pariksha radd hone se chhatron men aakrosh hai. daroga abhyarthiyon ne pradarshan kiya. pulis ne bairiket lagakar pradarshankariyon ko roka. dekhiye puri khabar.
About Channel:
ABP Bihar pradesh ki khabron ka ek aisa chainal hai jahan pradesh se juri har khabar aapke pas sabse pahle pahunchti hai. bihar ki rajniti, bihar ki barh, lalu - nitish ka ek dusre par palatvar, apradh ki andruni khabar aapke pas tathyon ke sath lekar aata hai.
